data.headline: Pre-sales and solutions head
data.about:
A graduate of NIT Trichy in Computer Science Engineering and a Management degree from IIM Bangalore, Dorai has close to two decades of experience in product management, solution  development, in Connected Car,  V2X (C-V2X, DSRC), Integrated Cockpit Systems

He holds a very strong technical experience which coupled to his strong roots in finance and marketing. 

Specialties:
Proven experience in identifying key market trends, managing product roadmap,strategic partnership  with ecosystem partners like Silicon vendors, independent IP providers towards licensing their technology and delivering a complete solution 
Represented organization in various industry forums showcasing solutions.
Have extensive experience working with global teams spread across North America, Europe, Asia

Has proven experience in evangelizing offerings with  with Automotive Tier-1 vendors and winning business 
Good knowledge/hands-on exposure to various software development methodologies including Agile.
Strategic decision making with respect to Buy Vs Make, negotiation with 3rd party vendors, co-ordination  with legal teams towards contract closure

description.text:
Create and manage Product Roadmap, Strategy and Product Marketing for Connected Car, V2X, Integrated Cockpit Systems Manage business growth, offer definition and solution development. .

Key Achievements:
•	Re-position key strengths in Multimedia, Connectivity to make inroads into Connected Car, V2X, Integrated Cockpit Systems
•	Responsible for defining solutions in automotive infotainment including definition of Roadmap, Product requirement definition document, prioritization  tracking progress, issue resolution helping win strategic accounts with Japanese Tier1s, North American OEM
* Drive solution development in areas of Connected Cars, V2X, Advanced telematics, Integrated Cockpit Systems, 

Evangelizing the solution with lead customer in order to acquire business
	Develop partnership with Silicon vendors, 3rd party vendors for C-V2X/DSRC, OS vendors to provide an integrated solution to customers.
•	Authored white papers - Connected Car, Android Auto, Internet of things, published in leading dailies.
Responsible for development of next generation  cloud based health care  suite. Leading a team responsible for feature definition, development and customer delivery

Responsibilities: 
•	Roadmap for Multimedia subsystems
o	Alignment of roadmap with mobile handset market trends, silicon architecture trends, OS trends
o	Define Product requirements definition document, prioritize features, track implementation of features 
•	Customer acquisition
•	Product Pricing
•	Manage Relationship with Silicon vendors, OS vendors and align the product roadmap with silicon and OS roadmap
•	Evaluate 3rd parties so as to in-source components which  offer competitive advantage
•	Liaison with legal team on contracts with respect  to IPR, Indemnification related issues

Achievements:
•	Licensed Multimedia Subsystems to Japanese, American, European Tier 1 OEMs
•	Migrated the relationship with a Japanese Handset OEM from just a licenser of codecs to licensing complete media player. This was a royalty bearing deal with significant volumes
•	Successful breakthrough into a North European OEM  (Now Japanese) for licensing Multimedia IP for use in their phones
•	Successfully helped grow the Licensing + services business with a North American OEM from < 1 Million to 5+ Million by penetrating into Multiple platforms/ Models and offering IP + services
•	Successful re-negotiation of rates with a supplier of http stack so as to optimize on costs

Description: As part of the Multimedia products team, responsible for development of various Multimedia products like Media player, Streaming Player/Protocols, Video telephony protocol stack (3G-324M), Customizing  and delivering on several customer platforms.  Had extensive experience in interacting with Japanese firms

Key activities:
System architecture, requirements management, project management, responding to customer RFPs/Pre-sales

Achievements:
•	Successfully delivery of   3G-324M based video telephony solution to several handset OEM including the world’s largest handset OEM (2006 era)
•	Successful delivery  of a media player for Japanese handset OEM. The media player was part of the first handset launched in 3 network in UK
•	Successfully delivery of    3gpp streaming server solution to a  South Korean Conglomerate
•	Represented Sasken at IMTC towards standardization of the Video telephony standard. Participated in interoperability  events, contributed towards marking the standard robust by identifying   conflict scenario and proposing solutions
•	Won multiple internal awards including the “Achiever of the Quarter”, “Team of the quarter” for individual and team contribution

Description: Worked on customer projects starting as a developer and moved on to be a senior developer. Gained good understanding of Network Operating Systems internals, Protocols, MPEG-2 TS, Device drivers, Conditional Access systems

Key activities:
Development of Conditional Access APIs for a North American satellite card vendor in a PC environment. Involved in device driver and middleware development in Windows NT OS Design, development, enhancements, maintenance of NCR’s advanced server for Unix MP-RAS.
